title: Fix test_local_ollama_lane.py assertions that contradict DEC-029/DEC-030
description: Found 2026-07-28 by lili-replacement-nisa during an independent health baseline (MAP_System/artifacts/tests/map-health-baseline-2026-07-28.md). MAP_System/tests/test_local_ollama_lane.py asserts that the CommandCenterUI template server.py should NOT contain ollama-goose/pi-lab-new and should retain the old hardcoded OLLAMA_URL/SUMMARY_MODEL. Those assertions directly contradict DEC-029 and DEC-030, which TASK-265 (RELEASED 2026-07-28, independently reviewed and APPROVED) correctly implemented. So the test now fails BECAUSE the code is right -- an inverted test, not a code regression. Secondary finding worth acting on: TASK-265's reviewer searched for affected tests using the test_command_center_* prefix and this file did not match that prefix, so an inverted assertion survived an otherwise sound review. That is a test-discovery gap, not reviewer error.
acceptance_criteria: test_local_ollama_lane.py asserts the behavior DEC-029 and DEC-030 actually mandate, and passes against the current template server.py without weakening what it checks (fix the assertions, do not delete the test or mark it skipped).
The test file records, in a comment naming DEC-029/DEC-030 and TASK-265, which prior assertions were inverted and why, so a future reader does not re-invert them.

The task record states how a CommandCenterUI-affecting test whose filename does not start with test_command_center_ should be discovered by a future reviewer, and either proposes a naming/discovery convention or explains why the existing suite registration in run_tests.sh is already sufficient.
MAP_System/scripts/run_tests.sh passes for this check and the total failure count drops by one relative to the 2026-07-28 baseline.
